set_preset_mode_with_duration.name: Set preset mode with duration
set_preset_mode_with_duration.description: Activate a preset (Boost, Party, Holiday, Leave) with a custom duration, or clear the current preset. Mode/preset/temperature can already be controlled via the generic climate.* actions - this action exists specifically to override a preset's vendor-default duration.

preset_mode.name: Preset
preset_mode.description: The preset to activate, or 'none' to clear the current preset.

target.name: Duration
target.description: Real-world duration in the preset's own unit and range — Boost: minutes (30–120, step 30); Party: hours (1–12); Leave: hours (1–12); Holiday: days (1–30). Not applicable when preset is 'none'.

set_hvac_mode_and_temperature.name: Set HVAC mode and temperature
set_hvac_mode_and_temperature.description: Set hvac_mode and a target temperature together in one reliable call. The standard climate.set_temperature action can technically accept both at once too, but does not reliably apply them together on this integration — use this action instead when you need to change both. temperature is ignored when hvac_mode is 'off' (the gateway silently rejects temperature changes while Standby is active).

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature in °C. Only applied when hvac_mode is 'auto'.

get_schedule_room.name: Get room schedule
get_schedule_room.description: Read a room's full weekly switching-time schedule from the gateway. Returns an object with one list per weekday (monday..sunday); each entry has from, to, and type — type is 'H' (Comfort Hi) or 'L' (Comfort Lo). A time not covered by any slot follows the room's implicit 'Night' behaviour. The response has the same shape set_schedule_room expects, so it can be read, edited, and written straight back.

set_schedule_room.name: Set room schedule
set_schedule_room.description: Write a room's full weekly switching-time schedule. This always replaces the ENTIRE week — the gateway has no partial-update endpoint, so read the current schedule via get_schedule_room first if you only want to change part of it. Up to 3 slots per weekday. Every defined slot must include from, to, AND type — there is no default type. A weekday left out of the schedule means no active slots that day.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Full weekly schedule as an object: one list per weekday (monday..sunday), each entry with from, to, and type - see get_schedule_room's response for the exact shape. Switch to YAML mode in Developer Tools → Actions to enter this.

set_schedule_room_weekday.name: Set room schedule for one weekday
set_schedule_room_weekday.description: Replace one weekday's switching-time slots, leaving every other day unchanged. Up to 3 slots (slot 1–3). For each slot you want to set, give its From, To, AND Type together — all three or none. Leave a slot's fields all empty to clear it.

weekday.name: Weekday
weekday.description: The day to update. All other days are left unchanged.

slot_1_from.name: Slot 1: From
slot_1_from.description: Start time of slot 1. Give To and Type as well, or leave all three empty to clear this slot.

slot_1_type.name: Slot 1: Type
slot_1_type.description: Comfort Hi or Comfort Lo for slot 1.

slot_2_from.name: Slot 2: From
slot_2_from.description: Start time of slot 2. Give To and Type as well, or leave all three empty to clear this slot.

slot_2_type.name: Slot 2: Type
slot_2_type.description: Comfort Hi or Comfort Lo for slot 2.

slot_3_from.name: Slot 3: From
slot_3_from.description: Start time of slot 3. Give To and Type as well, or leave all three empty to clear this slot.

slot_3_type.name: Slot 3: Type
slot_3_type.description: Comfort Hi or Comfort Lo for slot 3.
